lines: My ninjato flashed through the air.
But it didn't take their lives. The strikes were with the back of the blade.
If I killed them it would only have come back to bite me later.
This brat kinda knows how to fight!
At Gosha Academy, I was pretty much bottom tier in terms of fighting power.
However, I had overcome a lot of difficulties, and had repeatedly trained with Shikanosuke.
And before I knew it, my name had become widely known as the captain of the Independent Commando Unit.
Being outnumbered was something I had gotten fairly used to.
Guys! Don't let your guard down!!
I mean, I wouldn't mind if you let it down a little... Whoa!

Being alone had its advantages. Without having to worry about friendly fire, I could stealthily strike down some enemies from blind spots that I created by using other enemies as walls to hide myself.
Doing so, I was able to defeat five, even six of these guys.
I wanted to give myself a good pat on the back for that.
Hey!! What the fuck is taking you so long!? He's just a kid!!
Surround him and beat the shit out of him!!
It seemed like my number was up.
About twice as many as the six I had already downed came out as reinforcements. I had no choice but to go completely on the defensive.
And on top of that, the ones who had just arrived were a lot stronger than the first ones.
In the end I was surrounded and beaten up like a punching bag.
Heh! All bark and no bite, huh, kiddo.
What happened to your cockiness, huh?
I got to my wobbly feet after being beaten to a pulp as I'd expected (well, not really).
My body was covered with bruises, the inside of my mouth was filled with blood, my eyelids were cut, and my face was painfully swollen.
I was in a horrible state, but none of the wounds were deep enough to be fatal.
It was partly because the bodyguards didn't mean to kill me in the first place,
and mostly because I was good at rolling with the punches. I had always been the weakest since I was a kid, so I had to learn how to take a beating.
And thanks to the demonic power that I had recently awakened to, this level of injuries seemed to take me no time to heal.
The point was that I intentionally let them beat me up in order to get Kurenai's attention who was holed up here.
It seemed to have had some results.
Hey, weird kid. She wants to talk to you.
I couldn't tell if it was amazement or annoyance on his face as the bodyguard handed me a smartphone.
『Is that the way the head of the Fuma family does things now?』
I'd thought it would be Kurenai, but it wasn't.
But I knew who that voice belonged to.
Ayame-san? That second group was all Shinganji ninja, right? That's not fair.
『And what exactly did you come here for?』
I told you. I want to meet with Kurenai. I want to ask her something.
『Just so you know, I have you in my sights right now.』
You're not alone, are you? Where are your friends?
『I'm alone. Is it that strange, coming alone to meet with a childhood friend?』
Do you want to see what your brains look like? I'm not interested in pointless chit-chat.
『Ayame-san, you're good at sniping using your "Windreader" ability, right?』
Yeah, I never miss. So just answer. Where are your friends? What are you planning?
『Understood. Then, I'll ask you instead, Ayame-san. So tell me. Did you assassinate Sago Bungo?』
『Answer me. Did you assassinate Sago Bungo?』
Unfortunately I don't think you have the right to ask me questions, now do you?
Actually, he does have that right.
If you make any funny moves, I won't hesitate to put a bullet in you.
By the time Ayame sensed someone behind her, Yukikaze already had her gun in her back.
What a surprise. Did you know all along that I would set up a sniping position here?
I should've expected as much from someone acknowledged by Kurenai-sama. I lose.
Oops. Keep that bit between us, please. So, what was your question again?
Did you come all the way here just to ask that? Kurenai-sama would be disappointed if she knew.
It was your boss, Igawa Asagi.
